tasks.label: Deploy current staging and editor
args:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ubuntu/copilot-control-center
printf 'Host: '; hostname
printf 'Branch and revision: '; git branch --show-current; git rev-parse --short HEAD

test -f .env.staging || { echo 'Brak .env.staging — przerywam.'; exit 1; }
test -f .env.proxy || { echo 'Brak .env.proxy — przerywam.'; exit 1; }
grep -qx 'EDITOR_URL=https://editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/editor/' .env.staging || { if grep -q '^EDITOR_URL=' .env.staging; then echo 'EDITOR_URL ma inną wartość; przerywam bez zmian.'; exit 1; else printf '\nEDITOR_URL=https://editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/editor/\n' >> .env.staging; fi; }
grep -qx 'EDITOR_DOMAIN=editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com' .env.proxy || { if grep -q '^EDITOR_DOMAIN=' .env.proxy; then echo 'EDITOR_DOMAIN ma inną wartość; przerywam bez zmian.'; exit 1; else printf '\nEDITOR_DOMAIN=editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com\n' >> .env.proxy; fi; }
grep -qx 'CADDYFILE=./Caddyfile' .env.proxy || { echo 'Aktywny Caddyfile w .env.proxy nie wskazuje na ./Caddyfile; przerywam przed wdrożeniem.'; exit 1; }
chmod 600 .env.staging .env.proxy

printf '\nTworzenie backupu bazy staging...\n'
bash scripts/backup-postgres.sh staging
printf '\nBudowanie aplikacji web...\n'
(cd mobile && flutter build web --release)
printf '\nSprawdzanie sieci edytora...\n'
sudo docker network inspect ccc-editor-edge >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo docker network create ccc-editor-edge
printf '\nWdrażanie API i interfejsu staging...\n'
sudo env APP_ENV_FILE=.env.staging docker compose -p ccc-staging --env-file .env.staging up -d --build
printf '\nUruchamianie izolowanego edytora...\n'
sudo docker compose -f docker-compose.editor.yml -p ccc-staging-editor --env-file .env.staging up -d --build
printf '\nOdtwarzanie proxy z routingiem dla edytora...\n'
sudo env PROXY_ENV_FILE=.env.proxy docker compose -f docker-compose.proxy.yml -p ccc-proxy --env-file .env.proxy up -d --force-recreate caddy
printf '\nWeryfikacja kontenerów...\n'
sudo docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'
printf '\nTest HTTPS stagingu...\n'
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'Staging HTTP %{http_code}\n' --max-time 15 https://staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/
printf '\nTest HTTPS edytora (401 bez sesji jest oczekiwane)...\n'
curl -skI --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 15 https://editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/editor/

tasks.label: Deploy staging and editor
args:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ubuntu/copilot-control-center
echo Host:; hostname
echo Branch:; git branch --show-current
git rev-parse --short HEAD

test -f .env.staging || { echo Missing-staging-env; exit 1; }
test -f .env.proxy || { echo Missing-proxy-env; exit 1; }
grep -qx EDITOR_URL=https://editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/editor/ .env.staging || { if grep -q ^EDITOR_URL= .env.staging; then echo Editor-URL-mismatch; exit 1; else printf "\nEDITOR_URL=https://editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/editor/\n" >> .env.staging; fi; }
grep -qx EDITOR_DOMAIN=editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com .env.proxy || { if grep -q ^EDITOR_DOMAIN= .env.proxy; then echo Editor-domain-mismatch; exit 1; else printf "\nEDITOR_DOMAIN=editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com\n" >> .env.proxy; fi; }
grep -qx CADDYFILE=./Caddyfile .env.proxy || { echo Active-Caddyfile-mismatch; exit 1; }
chmod 600 .env.staging .env.proxy

echo Creating-staging-database-backup
bash scripts/backup-postgres.sh staging
echo Building-Flutter-Web
cd mobile
flutter build web --release
cd ..
echo Ensuring-editor-network
sudo docker network inspect ccc-editor-edge >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo docker network create ccc-editor-edge
echo Deploying-staging-api-and-ui
sudo env APP_ENV_FILE=.env.staging docker compose -p ccc-staging --env-file .env.staging up -d --build
echo Starting-isolated-editor
sudo docker compose -f docker-compose.editor.yml -p ccc-staging-editor --env-file .env.staging up -d --build
echo Recreating-Caddy-with-editor-routing
sudo env PROXY_ENV_FILE=.env.proxy docker compose -f docker-compose.proxy.yml -p ccc-proxy --env-file .env.proxy up -d --force-recreate caddy
echo Checking-running-containers
sudo docker ps
echo Checking-staging-HTTPS
curl -sSI --max-time 15 https://staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/
echo Checking-editor-HTTPS-unauthenticated-401-is-expected
curl -skI --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 15 https://editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/editor/

tasks.label: Check staging deploy tools
args:
cd /home/ubuntu/copilot-control-center
printf 'Flutter in PATH: '; command -v flutter || true
printf 'Known Flutter path: '; test -x /home/ubuntu/.local/flutter/bin/flutter && echo available || echo missing
printf 'Docker: '; sudo docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' 2>&1 | head -10
printf 'Environment files: '; test -f .env.staging && test -f .env.proxy && echo present || echo missing
printf 'Caddy env settings: '; grep -q '^CADDYFILE=./Caddyfile$' .env.proxy && echo default-Caddyfile || echo non-default-or-missing

tasks.label: Deploy current staging now
args:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ubuntu/copilot-control-center
echo Host; hostname
echo Revision; git rev-parse --short HEAD
test -f .env.staging
test -f .env.proxy
grep -qx EDITOR_URL=https://editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/editor/ .env.staging || { echo Editor-URL-missing-or-mismatch; exit 1; }
grep -qx EDITOR_DOMAIN=editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com .env.proxy || { echo Editor-domain-missing-or-mismatch; exit 1; }
grep -qx CADDYFILE=./Caddyfile .env.proxy || { echo Caddyfile-is-not-default; exit 1; }
if test -x /home/ubuntu/.local/flutter/bin/flutter; then FLUTTER=/home/ubuntu/.local/flutter/bin/flutter; elif command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then FLUTTER=flutter; else echo Flutter-not-installed; exit 1; fi
echo Building-Flutter-Web
cd mobile
"$FLUTTER" build web --release
cd ..
echo Ensure-editor-network
sudo docker network inspect ccc-editor-edge >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo docker network create ccc-editor-edge
echo Deploy-staging-api-and-ui
sudo env APP_ENV_FILE=.env.staging docker compose -p ccc-staging --env-file .env.staging up -d --build
echo Start-editor-container
sudo docker compose -f docker-compose.editor.yml -p ccc-staging-editor --env-file .env.staging up -d --build
echo Recreate-Caddy
sudo env PROXY_ENV_FILE=.env.proxy docker compose -f docker-compose.proxy.yml -p ccc-proxy --env-file .env.proxy up -d --force-recreate caddy
echo Containers
sudo docker ps
echo Test-staging
curl -sSI --max-time 15 https://staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/
echo Test-editor-unauthenticated
curl -skI --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 15 https://editor.staging.copilotcontrolcenter.com/editor/
